source_en: You're new, or I'm late. Petre Dolidze. Small parish above the north ridge.
I write poems. They go nowhere. I consider that a feature.
Why come down from the ridge?
Candles and flour. And I needed something with more than two walls.
God, I hope. The dog listens. Nobody else has asked.
A gray dog walks the ridge with me. Lately he won't come inside.
He stopped eating. He stands at the tree line and stares north.
My wife, once. She found the quiet too loud. I didn't.
Papers. The dog has none, but I vouch for him.
